column1: # Deliberately operator-invisible commands on the fno-agents binary: a dispatched
# command the unknown-command refusal never names. The ruling that owns this
# surface (2026-09-25: hidden top-level commands retire into nested groups) is
# carried by the fno-agents debt row in scripts/ci/menu-caps-debt.tsv; until a
# command folds, its invisibility is deliberate and recorded here, one row per
# command with the reason. Shrink-only: a row whose command becomes refusal-named,
# folds into a group, or disappears must go in the same PR. The command ratchet
# refuses a dispatched-but-unrecorded command and a stale row alike.
